_about: Public-domain Andrew C. Zenos, Presbyterian professor at McCormick Theological Seminary, for the Word Hoard: The Principles of the Higher Criticism, The Relations of New Testament Study to the Present Age, The Elements of the Higher Criticism, Compendium of Church History, The Teaching of Jesus concerning Christian Conduct, The Son of Man, and The Plastic Age of the Gospel. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
